channel.title: Cyber Threat Wall — Latest Movers
channel.description: Actively exploited vulnerabilities rising fastest in Cyber Threat Wall rankings.

item.title: CVE-2013-3346 — Adobe Reader and Acrobat
item.description: Threat Signal 76. Adobe Reader and Acrobat contain a memory corruption vulnerability which can allow attackers to execute arbitrary code or cause a denial of service.

item.title: CVE-2012-0391 — Apache Struts 2
item.description: Threat Signal 75. The ExceptionDelegator component in Apache Struts 2 before 2.2.3.1 contains an improper input validation vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2015-3043 — Adobe Flash Player
item.description: Threat Signal 75. A memory corruption vulnerability exists in Adobe Flash Player that allows an attacker to perform remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2016-1019 — Adobe Flash Player
item.description: Threat Signal 74. Adobe Flash Player allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service or possibly execute arbitrary code.

item.title: CVE-2022-20699 — Cisco Small Business RV160, RV260, RV340, and RV345 Series Routers
item.description: Threat Signal 74. A vulnerability in Cisco Small Business RV160, RV260, RV340, and RV345 Series Routers could allow an attacker to do any of the following: Execute arbitrary code elevate privileges, execute arbitrary commands, bypass authentication and authorization protections, fetch and run unsigned software, or cause a denial of service (DoS).

item.title: CVE-2020-5722 — Grandstream UCM6200
item.description: Threat Signal 77. Grandstream UCM6200 series is vulnerable to an unauthenticated remote SQL injection via crafted HTTP request. Exploitation can allow for code execution as root.

item.title: CVE-2021-22991 — F5 BIG-IP Traffic Management Microkernel
item.description: Threat Signal 72. The Traffic Management Microkernel of BIG-IP ASM Risk Engine has a buffer overflow vulnerability, leading to a bypassing of URL-based access controls.

item.title: CVE-2017-5689 — Intel Active Management Technology (AMT), Small Business Technology (SBT), and Standard Manageability
item.description: Threat Signal 78. Intel products contain a vulnerability which can allow attackers to perform privilege escalation.

item.title: CVE-2014-1776 — Microsoft Internet Explorer
item.description: Threat Signal 78. Microsoft Internet Explorer contains a memory corruption vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute code in the context of the current user.

item.title: CVE-2011-1889 — Microsoft Forefront Threat Management Gateway (TMG)
item.description: Threat Signal 70. A remote code execution vulnerability exists in the Forefront Threat Management Gateway (TMG) Firewall Client Winsock provider that could allow code execution in the security context of the client application.

item.title: CVE-2021-40870 — Aviatrix Aviatrix Controller
item.description: Threat Signal 79. Unrestricted upload of a file with a dangerous type is possible, which allows an unauthenticated user to execute arbitrary code via directory traversal.

item.title: CVE-2013-3897 — Microsoft Internet Explorer
item.description: Threat Signal 73. A use-after-free vulnerability exists within CDisplayPointer in Microsoft Internet Explorer that allows an attacker to remotely execute arbitrary code.

item.title: CVE-2021-25298 — Nagios Nagios XI
item.description: Threat Signal 73. Nagios XI contains a vulnerability which can lead to OS command injection on the Nagios XI server.

item.title: CVE-2013-0625 — Adobe ColdFusion
item.description: Threat Signal 79. Adobe Coldfusion contains an authentication bypass vulnerability, which could result in an unauthorized user gaining administrative access.

item.title: CVE-2013-0632 — Adobe ColdFusion
item.description: Threat Signal 79. An authentication bypass vulnerability exists in Adobe ColdFusion which could result in an unauthorized user gaining administrative access.

item.title: CVE-2011-3544 — Oracle Java SE JDK and JRE
item.description: Threat Signal 79. An access control vulnerability exists in the Applet Rhino Script Engine component of Oracle's Java Runtime Environment allows an attacker to remotely execute arbitrary code.

item.title: CVE-2022-23131 — Zabbix Frontend
item.description: Threat Signal 79. Unsafe client-side session storage leading to authentication bypass/instance takeover via Zabbix Frontend with configured SAML.

item.title: CVE-2013-1347 — Microsoft Internet Explorer
item.description: Threat Signal 74. This vulnerability may corrupt memory in a way that could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code in the context of the current user within Internet Explorer.

item.title: CVE-2017-6736 — Cisco IOS and IOS XE Software
item.description: Threat Signal 72. The Simple Network Management Protocol (SNMP) subsystem of Cisco IOS and IOS XE contains a vulnerability that could allow an authenticated, remote attacker to remotely execute code.

item.title: CVE-2012-1856 — Microsoft Office
item.description: Threat Signal 72. The TabStrip ActiveX control in the Common Controls in MSCOMCTL.OCX in Microsoft Office allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via a crafted (1) document or (2) web page that triggers system-state corruption.

item.title: CVE-2021-25296 — Nagios Nagios XI
item.description: Threat Signal 72. Nagios XI contains a vulnerability which can lead to OS command injection on the Nagios XI server.

item.title: CVE-2020-13927 — Apache Airflow's Experimental API
item.description: Threat Signal 80. The previous default setting for Airflow's Experimental API was to allow all API requests without authentication.

item.title: CVE-2021-36260 — Hikvision Security cameras web server
item.description: Threat Signal 80. A command injection vulnerability in the web server of some Hikvision product. Due to the insufficient input validation.

item.title: CVE-2022-24086 — Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
item.description: Threat Signal 80. Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source contain an improper input validation vulnerability which can allow for arbitrary code execution.

item.title: CVE-2017-9841 — PHPUnit PHPUnit
item.description: Threat Signal 80. PHPUnit allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary PHP code via HTTP POST data beginning with a "<?php " substring, as demonstrated by an attack on a site with an exposed /vendor folder, i.e., external access to the /vendor/phpunit/phpunit/src/Util/PHP/eval-stdin.php URI.

item.title: CVE-2018-1000861 — Jenkins Jenkins Stapler Web Framework
item.description: Threat Signal 80. A code execution vulnerability exists in the Stapler web framework used by Jenkins

item.title: CVE-2017-9791 — Apache Struts 1
item.description: Threat Signal 80. The Struts 1 plugin in Apache Struts might allow remote code execution via a malicious field value passed in a raw message to the ActionMessage.

item.title: CVE-2016-3088 — Apache ActiveMQ
item.description: Threat Signal 80. The Fileserver web application in Apache ActiveMQ allows remote attackers to upload and execute arbitrary files via an HTTP PUT followed by an HTTP MOVE request

item.title: CVE-2015-1635 — Microsoft HTTP.sys
item.description: Threat Signal 80. Microsoft HTTP protocol stack (HTTP.sys) contains a vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2014-6271 — GNU Bourne-Again Shell (Bash)
item.description: Threat Signal 80. GNU Bash through 4.3 processes trailing strings after function definitions in the values of environment variables, which allows remote attackers to execute code.

item.title: CVE-2014-7169 — GNU Bourne-Again Shell (Bash)
item.description: Threat Signal 80. GNU Bash through 4.3 processes trailing strings after function definitions in the values of environment variables, which allows remote attackers to execute code. This CVE correctly remediates the vulnerability in CVE-2014-6271.

item.title: CVE-2020-1938 — Apache Tomcat
item.description: Threat Signal 80. Apache Tomcat treats Apache JServ Protocol (AJP) connections as having higher trust than, for example, a similar HTTP connection. If such connections are available to an attacker, they can be exploited.

item.title: CVE-2015-5119 — Adobe Flash Player
item.description: Threat Signal 80. A use-after-free vulnerability exists within the ActionScript 3 ByteArray class in Adobe Flash Player that allows an attacker to perform remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2021-32648 — October CMS October CMS
item.description: Threat Signal 76. In affected versions of the october/system package an attacker can request an account password reset and then gain access to the account using a specially crafted request.

item.title: CVE-2017-8464 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 76. Windows Shell in multiple versions of Microsoft Windows allows local users or remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via a crafted .LNK file

item.title: CVE-2012-1535 — Adobe Flash Player
item.description: Threat Signal 70. Unspecified vulnerability in Adobe Flash Player allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code or cause a denial of service via crafted SWF content.

item.title: CVE-2017-8540 — Microsoft Malware Protection Engine
item.description: Threat Signal 70. The Microsoft Malware Protection Engine running on Microsoft Forefront and Microsoft Defender on Microsoft Windows Server 2008 SP2 and R2 SP1, Windows 7 SP1, Windows 8.1, Windows Server 2012 Gold and R2, Windows RT 8.1, Windows 10 Gold, 1511, 1607, and 1703, and Windows Server 2016, Microsoft Exchange Server 2013 and 2016, does not properly scan a specially crafted file leading to memory corruption. aka "Microsoft Malware Protection Engine Remote Code Execution Vulnerability".

item.title: CVE-2015-2051 — D-Link DIR-645 Router
item.description: Threat Signal 77. D-Link DIR-645 Wired/Wireless Router allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary commands via a GetDeviceSettings action to the HNAP interface.

item.title: CVE-2014-1761 — Microsoft Word
item.description: Threat Signal 71. Microsoft Word contains a memory corruption vulnerability which when exploited could allow for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2021-25297 — Nagios Nagios XI
item.description: Threat Signal 69. Nagios XI contains a vulnerability which can lead to OS command injection on the Nagios XI server.

item.title: CVE-2014-6352 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 72. Microsoft Windows allow remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via a crafted OLE object.

item.title: CVE-2017-0262 — Microsoft Office
item.description: Threat Signal 72. A remote code execution vulnerability exists in Microsoft Office.

item.title: CVE-2017-11826 — Microsoft Office
item.description: Threat Signal 72. A remote code execution vulnerability exists in Microsoft Office software when the software fails to properly handle objects in memory. An attacker who successfully exploited the vulnerability could run arbitrary code in the context of the current user.

item.title: CVE-2017-0261 — Microsoft Office
item.description: Threat Signal 72. Microsoft Office contains a use-after-free vulnerability which can allow for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2014-4114 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 72. A vulnerability exists in Windows Object Linking & Embedding (OLE) that could allow remote code execution if a user opens a file that contains a specially crafted OLE object.

item.title: CVE-2019-16928 — Exim Exim Internet Mailer
item.description: Threat Signal 68. Exim contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability which can allow for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2018-8581 — Microsoft Exchange Server
item.description: Threat Signal 70. A privilege escalation vulnerability exists in Microsoft Exchange Server. An attacker who successfully exploited this vulnerability could attempt to impersonate any other user of the Exchange server.

item.title: CVE-2018-8298 — ChakraCore ChakraCore scripting engine
item.description: Threat Signal 70. The ChakraCore scripting engine contains a type confusion vulnerability which can allow for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2016-0099 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 73. A privilege escalation vulnerability exists in Microsoft Windows if the Windows Secondary Logon Service fails to properly manage request handles in memory. An attacker who successfully exploited this vulnerability could run arbitrary code as an administrator.

item.title: CVE-2015-2545 — Microsoft Office
item.description: Threat Signal 73. Microsoft Office allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via a crafted EPS image.
